title: ee.mesh.memory_event.v1
$comment: DRAFT — pre-implementation artifact for bd-tc-epic-qzk7o.3.1 (T2.0). NOT registered, NOT emitted yet. The additionalProperties:false closed allowlist IS the contract the bead pins: everything not listed here is structurally excluded, which is how the non-leak goldens get their teeth. Field spellings marked TBD are the implementer's to finalize.
description: Typed memory payload of an origin event. Operations are create | revise | tombstone | shareWithdraw (the schema has NO update kind — the revision kind is REVISE; trust/validity/bodyAvailable events are explicitly deferred post-v1 per amended ADR 0086 TC-D3/D12: body-fetch eligibility is computed serve-side at fetch time). The closed metadata allowlist EXCLUDES: body text, title/first-line/preview, tags, provenance URIs, raw paths, evidence bodies, and the commitment nonce. Bodies move out-of-band via authorized body fetch and verify against the salted bodyCommitment; an immutable ledger body would contradict shareWithdraw purge semantics.

logicalMemoryId.description: Provenance-safe opaque logical identity; stable across revisions.

revisionId.description: Provenance-safe opaque revision identity; fresh per revision.

predecessorRevisionId.description: Prior revision for revise/tombstone/shareWithdraw; null for create.

level.$comment: TBD: whether to reuse the workspace level vocabulary verbatim.

memoryKind.$comment: TBD: spelled memoryKind to avoid colliding with the operation field.

projectBinding.description: Opaque project identity (T3.5 cross-machine equivalence); never a path.

originTrustClaim.description: Bounded origin trust claim; receivers derive effective trust themselves (T5.2/T5.3) — this is a claim, not an instruction.

provenanceRefs.description: Provenance-safe opaque IDs only — never URIs, paths, or evidence bodies.

bodyRepresentation.$comment: TBD vocabulary: how the (withheld) body is represented/encoded for fetch.

redactionProvenance.description: Which redaction policy produced the shareable form.

bodyCommitment.description: Salted commitment: blake3, domain-separated, over a fresh 32-byte nonce plus the exact body bytes. The nonce is body-fetch-only and NEVER appears in metadata; equal bodies across revisions are unlinkable to metadata-only peers. Metadata-only search may filter allowed fields and must render a missing-body placeholder — never claim full-text recall.
